name: pop
text: Pop is built around catchy melodies, clear hooks and polished production aimed at a wide audience. In this catalog the label comes from playlists, so it spans very different sounds, from dance-oriented tracks to indie-leaning songs.

name: rap
text: Rap centers on rhythmic spoken vocals over beats, with the delivery and lyrics as the main focus. In this catalog it spans trap, southern, gangster and classic hip hop styles.

name: rock
text: Rock is guitar-driven music, usually with drums and bass, ranging from melodic classic rock to heavy, distorted hard rock. It is often loud and energetic, with a live-band feel.

name: r&b
text: R&B blends soulful, melodic vocals with groove-oriented rhythm. It ranges from smooth, mellow neo soul to rhythmic, dance-friendly styles.

name: edm
text: Electronic dance music is made for clubs and festivals, built on synthesized sounds, steady danceable beats and dramatic builds and drops. It is mostly electronic rather than acoustic.

name: latin
text: Latin music covers Spanish- and Portuguese-language styles and Latin-influenced pop and urban music, with rhythmic, danceable grooves. Because genre labels here come from playlists, some tracks are Latin-influenced rather than strictly Latin.

name: big room
text: Big room is a festival-oriented style of EDM with huge, simple melodic leads, heavy kick drums and dramatic build-ups and drops. It is loud and high-energy by design.

name: electro house
text: Electro house combines house music's steady four-on-the-floor beat with aggressive, distorted synth bass and sharp, punchy sound design. It is club-focused and high-energy.

name: pop edm
text: Pop EDM pairs electronic dance production with pop song structure: vocal hooks, bright melodies and drops that stay radio-friendly.

name: progressive electro house
text: Progressive electro house uses longer, gradual builds and layered melodies over electro house sounds, aiming for an emotional, anthemic feel.

name: latin hip hop
text: Latin hip hop blends rap vocals, often in Spanish, with Latin rhythms and urban beats.

name: latin pop
text: Latin pop mixes pop songwriting with Latin rhythms and instrumentation, usually with melodic, romantic or danceable songs.

name: reggaeton
text: Reggaeton is built on the dembow rhythm, a steady syncopated beat, with rapped and sung vocals over it. It is made to be danced to.

name: tropical
text: Tropical music here covers warm, rhythmic styles with Caribbean and Latin influences. The playlist labels are broad, so it also includes some tropical house, a relaxed, summery electronic style.

name: dance pop
text: Dance pop is pop built for the dance floor: upbeat tempos, bright synths and strong, repetitive hooks.

name: electropop
text: Electropop centers synthesizers and electronic production within pop songs, from glossy and bright to moody and minimal.

name: indie poptimism
text: Indie poptimism describes pop-leaning songs with an independent, often offbeat sensibility, mixing pop hooks with more experimental or lo-fi touches.

name: post-teen pop
text: Post-teen pop is a contemporary pop style with moody, minimalist production and confessional lyrics, often with muted melodies and a laid-back, emotional tone.

name: hip pop
text: Hip pop blends R&B vocals with hip hop beats and a pop-friendly sound.

name: neo soul
text: Neo soul updates classic soul with jazz harmony, hip hop influences and relaxed, intimate vocals. It tends to feel warm, smooth and mellow.

name: new jack swing
text: New jack swing fuses R&B vocals with hip hop drum programming and swung rhythms. It was popular in the late 1980s and early 1990s.

name: urban contemporary
text: Urban contemporary is modern R&B with hip hop influences, smooth vocals and polished, rhythmic production.

name: gangster rap
text: Gangster rap is a hard-edged style of hip hop that focuses on street life, with heavy beats and direct, often aggressive delivery.

name: hip hop
text: Hip hop in this subgenre is the classic rap style: boom-bap or sample-based beats under rhythmic, lyric-focused vocals.

name: southern hip hop
text: Southern hip hop comes from the southern United States and is known for bass-heavy beats, slower grooves and distinctive regional flows.

name: trap
text: Trap is a style of hip hop with fast, stuttering hi-hats, deep 808 bass and sparse, dark atmospheres.

name: album rock
text: Album rock is rock aimed at full-album listening, with polished studio production, long-form songwriting and a broad range of moods.

name: classic rock
text: Classic rock covers influential guitar-driven rock from roughly the 1960s to the 1980s: strong riffs, melodic hooks and live-band energy.

name: hard rock
text: Hard rock turns up rock's volume and intensity with distorted guitars, heavy riffs and powerful vocals.

name: permanent wave
text: Permanent wave is a Spotify label for new wave and alternative rock from the late 1970s onward, mixing rock guitars with synths and a stylish, often melodic sound.

name: happy
text: In this app, a happy song has high energy (0.60 or more) and a positive valence (0.50 or more): upbeat, bright and lively.

name: intense
text: In this app, an intense song has high energy (0.60 or more) but a lower valence (below 0.50): driving, powerful or darker in tone.

name: chill
text: In this app, a chill song has lower energy (below 0.60) and a positive valence (0.50 or more): relaxed, easygoing and pleasant.

name: sad
text: In this app, a sad song has lower energy (below 0.60) and a very low valence (below 0.30): slow and somber.

name: melancholic
text: In this app, a melancholic song has lower energy (below 0.60) and a valence from 0.30 up to 0.50: wistful, reflective and bittersweet.

name: energy
text: Energy runs from 0 to 1 and measures intensity and activity. Loud, fast, noisy tracks score high, and calm, quiet tracks score low.

name: valence
text: Valence runs from 0 to 1 and describes how positive a track sounds, shown in the app as positivity. High values sound happy or cheerful, and low values sound sad, tense or angry.

name: acousticness
text: Acousticness runs from 0 to 1 and measures confidence that a track uses acoustic instruments rather than electronic sounds. High values mean a mostly acoustic sound.
